_how: Hand-written test messages for app/triage.py, labelled with the banner that should show (emergency, urgent, support, none). Run: python tests/triage_eval.py. Hard negatives on purpose: general questions about symptoms, the past, other people, mild long-standing complaints. Not real patient data.
